name: homie
description: A studio in a box on your own Cloudflare: set up a studio (one repository for games, music, videos and posts) with a setup status of your accounts and tools and a step-by-step checklist, plan each game in a short interview that becomes its Game Codex (a page in the game's own look that you can read and steer, kept up to date, with the build's progress on it), build with one agent or several in parallel, make or remix multiplayer web games or make an existing single-player game multiplayer, give games sound effects and synthesized music made on your own computer for free, make songs and game scores with ElevenLabs Music on your own account, make covers and painted art with fal on your own account under a budget, playtest a game on a computer and a phone with measured checks and a blind review, make gameplay trailers and music videos (captured from your game, or generated with fal under a budget with receipts), run the studio's site (the same sections as homie.rocks in the studio's own look, an epic landing page for every game, news posts with feeds) and public rooms (up to 32 players a room, shareable from the play page) on its own Cloudflare account (free plan, no payment method), list it in the homie.rocks directory, read the studio's own stats (counts, never tracking), and run its live games from a back office (who is playing now, in-game announcements, kick and mute, close a room, players per room, private / invite-only beta / public launch states with invite codes, and a remix switch; the owner confirms anything that takes something away with one tap). Beta.

interface.shortDescription: Studios for games, music and video on your own Cloudflare
interface.longDescription: Set up a studio as one repository (games, music, videos, posts) with a setup status of your accounts and tools and a checklist that never jumps ahead, plan each game in a short interview that becomes its Game Codex (a page in the game's own palette, fonts and art, kept up to date, with a live build status), build with one agent or several in parallel, make or remix multiplayer web games, make an existing single-player web game multiplayer where strangers meet in public rooms (every browser renders, bots fill seats, rounds restart), give a game sound effects and a synthesized theme made on your own computer for free (measured, wired in, starting on the first touch), make songs and game scores with ElevenLabs Music on your own account, make a cover from a real frame of the game and painted art with fal on your own account under a budget, playtest a game on a computer and a phone held both ways (first ten seconds, look, UI, real sound, a round, the owner control tests) with a blind review, make gameplay trailers and music videos (captured from your game, or generated with fal on your own account, under a budget with receipts), preview locally, deploy the studio's site to its own Cloudflare account on the free plan (no payment method; rooms of up to 32 players), list the games in the homie.rocks directory, read the studio's own stats, and run the live games from a back office (who is playing, announcements, kick and mute, closed rooms, invite-only betas and private games, a remix switch; the owner confirms what takes something away with one tap). Beta: report issues at github.com/homie-rocks/homie/issues.
